metadata.name: AME2020 published ground-state energies

papers.title: The AME2020 atomic mass evaluation (I). Evaluation of input data, and adjustment procedures
papers.citation: W. J. Huang et al., Chinese Physics C 45, 030002 (2021)

papers.title: The AME2020 atomic mass evaluation (II). Tables, graphs and references
papers.citation: M. Wang et al., Chinese Physics C 45, 030003 (2021)

quantity_transformations.BE: A × published BEA; uncertainty A × published BEA uncertainty; original BEA tokens retained; no independent nucleon-mass recombination

metadata.value_columns: Reaction identity: A[1:4], element[5:8], Z[8:11]; values begin[12], six22-column blocks of value12+uncertainty10; zero-based Python slices
metadata.uncertainty_scope: Published evaluated one-standard-deviation uncertainties, including AME mass correlations; not independent-error propagation and not a new mass adjustment.
metadata.flags: Value and uncertainty # flags are separate; # replaces decimal point; * is unavailable, never zero.

validation.central_value_tolerance: Sum of half-last-printed-digits from each surviving mass coefficient and published value, plus 1e-8 numerical slack; no uncertainty-derived tolerance
validation.uncertainty_comparison: Not compared to independent mass propagation: published evaluated uncertainties retain AME correlations; New/model propagation is a different calculation.
